label: Screening levels from SurgeSight's own thresholds. Not an IMD warning.

notes.wind_kmh: Sustained 10 m wind. 62 and 89 km/h are the IMD cyclonic storm and severe cyclonic storm limits; 40 km/h is where damage to weak structures begins.
notes.rain_mm_h: IMD heavy (64.5), very heavy (115.6) and extremely heavy (204.4) mm per day, divided by 24 h. Instantaneous rates run higher, so treat as a floor.
